description: This file defines a static class DriverFactory that manages the creation and disposal of WebDriver instances for different browsers in automated tests. It includes methods to create a browser driver based on configuration, set timeouts, and quit the driver.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: Provides static methods to create, manage, and dispose WebDriver instances for browser automation testing.

methods.name: CreateDriver
methods.description: Initializes WebDriver based on specified browser and configuration, setting options and timeouts.

methods.name: QuitDriver
methods.description: Quits the current WebDriver instance and resets the driver reference.
